# Clyvora

> Clyvora, also known as Clyvora Tech or Clyvora Technologies, creates free, source-available, privacy-first browser tools for working with data and media.

Clyvora tools process selected files locally on the user's device. They do not require an account and do not send selected files to a Clyvora conversion or processing server.

## Official projects

- [Clyvora Lens](https://www.lens.clyvora.tech/): Inspect, search, filter, and convert JSON and CSV files locally in the browser.
- [mewvi by Clyvora](https://mewvi.xyz/): Public media downloads and local audio/video conversion. Formerly Clyvora Convert; mewvi.xyz is its canonical address. Currently in beta. Local files stay on-device; public links use Clyvora infrastructure and source platforms. Downloads, playlists, and public collection availability vary by provider.
- [Live op Weg](https://liveopweg.nl/): Live train locations on a map.
- Existing tools: [Resize](https://www.resize.clyvora.tech/) for local images and [Fetch](https://www.fetch.clyvora.tech/) for supported public links.

Requested public-link retrieval sends the submitted URL to ClyvoraAPI and the supported source platform. Local files remain on-device. This public catalogue includes only already publicly discoverable projects.
- [Clyvora on GitHub](https://github.com/Clyvora): Official source repositories for Clyvora projects.
- [About Clyvora](https://www.clyvora.tech/about/): Brand identity, mission, privacy model, and official project links.

## Official names

- Primary brand name: Clyvora
- Alternate names: Clyvora Tech; Clyvora Technologies
- Official website: https://www.clyvora.tech/
